correctness.rationale: The full seven-state SIS CTMC transient generator (all nonzero 3-bit states) was independently reconstructed, inverted symbolically, and matched the displayed five-class rational mean. For unequal endpoints u=x+h,v=x-h, exact factor after z=x^2-h^2 has positive coefficients in 55 numerator monomials and 16 denominator monomials (independently reproduced in exact SymPy), proving strict endpoint symmetrization. For equal endpoints, derivative has quintic with signs (+,+,-,-,-,-) and P_r(1/2)<0<P_r(1), so unique t in (1/2,1) is global minimum over all budget allocations; boundary zero cure gives infinite expected time. Independent exact-rational examples r=1/2,1,9/10 agree. No general-graph or alternate-initial-state extension.
residual_risks: Symmetrization depends on a nontrivial 55/16-positive coefficient certificate, reconstructed independently; exact algebra not a formal proof assistant.
